parameters.name: HostAccountId
parameters.description:
The ID of the host account that you want to delete.
> You can call the [ListHostAccounts](~~204372~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to delete resides.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account resides.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
